## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Describe the relevant tests or manual checks and any known limits.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code and any included data/assets.
- [ ] I retained required license/attribution notices.
- [ ] User guides and API docstrings reflect changed behavior.
- [ ] Architecture diagrams reflect changed ownership or dependencies, if applicable.
- [ ] Doxygen builds without warnings when API comments or reference pages change.
- [ ] Any example/test data is synthetic or explicitly publishable.
